contexts.text: They shall bury in Tophet, because there is no more a place to bury in () = where all truths and goods have been consumed.

Tophet () = the Hell where reigns the direful and fierce love of destroying all the truths and goods of the Church, especially that where reigns the fierce cupidity of destroying the goods of innocence.
Under Hinnom, see this reference. AE 1083.
